clue.text: Get around premium for insurance on shell of vehicle by showing sign of fire and third-party damage cause

parts.note: to pass an obstacle is to get around it

indicators.note: premium means top or foremost, so the top letter of the next word is taken
a shell is the outside casing, so only the outer letters of the next word are used

parts.note: something smoking shows that there is fire

explanation.surface: A motorist pays extra insurance after their car is burnt out by somebody else.
explanation.walkthrough: The insurance vocabulary makes 'third-party damage' look like a claim; it is harm to bystanders from other people's cigarettes.
explanation.definitionFit: Inhaling others' tobacco fumes harms people who are not smoking themselves, so it is damage done to a third party.

clue.text: Year-on-year, eighth of remuneration's cut? Strike!

indicators.note: the picked letter is cut out of the longer word

parts.note: something happening year-on-year is annual

indicators.note: the eighth letter of the word remuneration is the one picked

explanation.surface: A worker whose annual pay rise has been trimmed calls for industrial action.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strike!' looks like the workers' response, but it means strike out, cancel.
explanation.definitionFit: To strike something out, such as a ruling or a contract, is to cancel it formally.

clue.text: Disturbed state of lover leaving note

indicators.note: the note goes away from the lover

parts.note: a mistress is a lover
MI (also spelt ME) is the third note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Someone is upset after their lover walks out leaving only a note.
explanation.definitionFit: Strain and anxiety are a troubled condition of mind.

clue.text: State judge getting the chop over racket is bloodsucker

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first part sits over the next

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia

indicators.note: the head of the word is chopped off, losing its first letter

parts.note: an umpire judges a game
a bat, as in table tennis, is a racket

explanation.surface: A judge in some state is sacked over a scandal and branded a parasite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'racket' suggests a scam, but it is a bat, as used in table tennis.
explanation.definitionFit: This tropical American mammal feeds on the blood of animals, so it is a literal bloodsucker.

clue.text: Regiment first to have band

parts.note: the SAS is the Special Air Service regiment of the British Army

indicators.note: the first letter of the word have is taken

explanation.surface: A regiment is the first to get its own military band.
explanation.definitionFit: A sash is a band of cloth worn over the shoulder or round the waist.

clue.text: Nothing changes where eggs come from

parts.note: nothing is zero, the letter O
something that changes varies

explanation.surface: A shrug that nothing ever changes on the farm where the eggs come from.
explanation.definitionFit: Female reproductive organs produce ova, the egg cells.

clue.text: Sketched alternatives that faced UK voters vis-a-vis EU policy

parts.words: alternatives that faced UK voters vis-a-vis EU
parts.note: the 2016 referendum asked British voters whether to stay in or get out of the European Union
a party line is its policy

explanation.surface: A summary of the Brexit referendum choice and the EU policy that followed.
explanation.definitionFit: Something drawn only as its outer contour or summarised briefly is sketched.

clue.text: Be disciplined and start putting the genie back in the bottle?

definitions.meaning: to be punished or severely rebuked, an idiom

definitions.text: start putting the genie back in the bottle?
definitions.meaning: to begin restoring the genie you must first get it into the narrow top of the bottle

explanation.surface: Someone is told off and must try to undo what they have unleashed.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to receive harsh punishment or criticism, and literally describes getting something into a bottle's narrow top.

clue.text: Perhaps fly round, racing wildly with active sign of doubt suppressed

indicators.note: the hesitation is held down inside the scrambled letters
racing wildly suggests the letters of the two words are thrown into disorder

parts.note: um is the hesitant noise of someone unsure

explanation.surface: A pilot racing round the globe keeps any doubts to themself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'active' looks like a description of the racing, but it is anagram fodder too; 'Perhaps' marks flying round as one example of going round the globe.
explanation.definitionFit: Flying all the way round the world is one way of travelling right round it.

clue.text: Funny or amusing fool

indicators.note: funny means odd, so the letters are rearranged in an odd way

explanation.surface: A fool may be funny or amusing.
explanation.definitionFit: An ignorant or stupid person is a fool.

clue.text: Put on fitting clothing for function

indicators.note: the fitting word wraps round the function like clothes

parts.note: something fitting is apt
a do is a party or social function

explanation.surface: Someone puts on suitable clothes for a formal function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Put on' with clothing nearby suggests dressing, but here it means assume, as in putting on an accent.
explanation.definitionFit: To take up a manner or accent is to assume it, a sense close to taking it on as one's own.

clue.text: More than one giant company with negative balance sheet requiring investment to start

parts.note: accounts in the red show a loss

indicators.note: only the opening letter of investment is used

explanation.surface: A huge firm in the red needs fresh capital to get going.
explanation.definitionFit: The plural of the Greek word for a huge statue, used for anything gigantic.

clue.text: Drink a toast to absent regulars in order

indicators.note: the even-placed letters are made absent, leaving the odd ones

explanation.surface: Pub drinkers raise a glass to friends who are not there.
explanation.walkthrough: 'regulars' sounds like pub customers, but it means letters at regular intervals, here the ones removed.
explanation.definitionFit: A decree imposed by an authority without consent is a command, an order.

clue.text: It's sickening to maintain course of action, feeling as you do for me?

definitions.text: feeling as you do for me?

indicators.note: to maintain is to hold, so the first word holds the second

parts.note: an emetic is something that makes you vomit
a path is a course of action

explanation.surface: Someone complains that it is sickening to persist with a plan, hoping for sympathy.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharing another person's feelings, as if in their place, describes someone sensitive to others.

clue.text: Slough's publicity lacking in respect

definitions.note: read as slough is, a slough being a bog

indicators.note: the publicity is missing from the word for respect

parts.note: to respect someone is to admire them
an ad is publicity

explanation.surface: A complaint that the town of Slough's promotion is not respected.
explanation.walkthrough: SLOUGH is a town west of London, but here a slough is a swamp.
explanation.definitionFit: A slough is a swampy patch of ground, a bog.

clue.text: The peaks and troughs are palpable with this aid plan

definitions.text: The peaks and troughs are palpable with this

parts.note: relief is aid given to those in need
a map is a plan of an area

explanation.surface: An aid scheme meant to smooth out economic highs and lows.
explanation.walkthrough: 'peaks and troughs' suggests economic cycles; it means hills and valleys shown in raised form.
explanation.definitionFit: A chart with raised contours lets you feel hills and valleys with your fingers.

clue.text: How mercenary might get paid leave

definitions.meaning: a hired soldier is paid by each assignment, a fee per job
leave is consent, as in asking leave to go

explanation.surface: A soldier of fortune collects pay and takes some time off.
explanation.definitionFit: Leave in the sense of authorisation or consent to do something.

clue.text: Salt beans, a meal to stew

indicators.note: stewing mixes the ingredients up, so the letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A cooking instruction: season beans and stew them for a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Salt' looks like a verb in the recipe; it is a noun, an old sailor.
explanation.definitionFit: An old salt is a seasoned sailor, and a rated seaman holds that rank in the navy.

clue.text: Basic log function

parts.note: a spar is a pole or length of timber
TAN is short for tangent, a trigonometric function

explanation.surface: Logarithms are a basic mathematical function.
explanation.walkthrough: 'log function' suggests logarithm; log is a piece of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: Austere, without comfort or luxury, like ancient Sparta: simple and plain.

clue.text: Expression of indifference about head of social network

indicators.note: the shrug goes about, around, the letter

parts.note: meh is a shrugging word for not caring

indicators.note: the head of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone shrugs at the boss of a social network.
explanation.definitionFit: A net, a web of crossing threads, is a network.

clue.text: Watering hole north of port district

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first part sits north of the second

parts.note: a bar is a watering hole where people drink
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A bar north of the port area.
explanation.definitionFit: A Spanish-speaking quarter of a city, a neighbourhood.

clue.text: You'll have to go to the ends of the earth to find this top hat

definitions.text: You'll have to go to the ends of the earth to find this top hat

parts.words: You'll have to go to the ends of the earth to find this top hat
parts.note: the poles are the ends of the earth, and the frozen covering there sits on top like a hat

explanation.surface: A fashion hunter must search the whole world for a particular top hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A permanent frozen layer covering polar regions crowns the globe like headwear.

clue.text: Encourage to try small size

parts.note: to hear a case is to try it in court
ten is a small clothing size in the UK

explanation.surface: A shop assistant urges a customer to try on a small size.
explanation.definitionFit: To give someone heart, raising their spirits, is to encourage them.

clue.text: Giant beat it inside

indicators.note: one word goes inside the other

parts.note: to tan someone's hide is to beat them

explanation.surface: A giant beat the stuffing out of something.
explanation.definitionFit: The Titans were a race of giant gods in Greek myth.

clue.text: Reveal ill-mannered person on tape?

indicators.note: a sound recording on tape is heard rather than seen, so it is the sound that counts

parts.note: a bear is a rough, surly person

explanation.surface: Exposing a rude person by recording them.
explanation.definitionFit: To uncover or lay open something is to reveal it.

clue.text: A shy, retiring one's going to confess

indicators.note: one is the Roman numeral I, and it goes from the word
retiring means drawing back, so the word for shy is read backwards

parts.note: a shy person is timid

explanation.surface: A shy, retiring person is about to confess.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retiring' turns TIMID into DIMIT, and 'one's going' removes its I to leave DMIT.
explanation.definitionFit: To own up or acknowledge a fault is to confess it.

clue.text: Inflamed, hot turning to cold? This expert may assess one's colouring

definitions.text: This expert may assess one's colouring

indicators.note: one letter turns into the other

parts.note: arthritic joints are inflamed
H is the abbreviation for hot on taps
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: Joints that are inflamed and hot cooling down, then a doctor assessing a patient's complexion.
explanation.walkthrough: 'colouring' suggests a complexion; it is painting, someone's use of colour.
explanation.definitionFit: A reviewer of paintings judges, among other things, how the painter uses colour.

clue.text: Bill to firm up next case once redeployed

indicators.note: redeployed means rearranged for a new use, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A worker is redeployed once the next case comes up.
explanation.definitionFit: Business costs are charged to the employer on this arrangement, so it is a way of billing the company.
